name: OPUS-100
description: A multilingual parallel-corpus dataset comprising English-centric translation pairs for 100 languages, intended for machine translation research.
citation: Zhang, B., Williams, A., Titov, I., & Sennrich, R. (2020). Improving Massively Multilingual Neural Machine Translation and Zero-Shot Translation. Proceedings of the 58th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 1628–1639. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2020.acl-main.148
